settings.title: 🔒 Privacy Guarantee
settings.content: Your privacy is our priority. We never sell, trade, or compromise your personal data or contact details to third-party marketers.

settings.title: 1. Information We Collect
settings.content:
When you visit Kisan Bazar or place an order, we collect essential personal information required to process and deliver your items:

  • Contact Details: Full Name, Email Address, Phone Number
  • Delivery Information: Shipping & Billing Address, Pincode
  • Order & Payment Logs: Transaction ID, Payment Method (we do NOT store credit card CVV or passwords)

settings.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
settings.content:
We use your information exclusively to provide a seamless farm-to-table shopping experience:

  • Processing and fulfilling your organic food orders
  • Sending SMS and WhatsApp delivery tracking notifications
  • Improving our store offerings, product freshness, and customer support
  • Sending optional promotional offers (you can unsubscribe anytime)

settings.title: 3. Data Security & Storage
settings.content: We implement industry-standard 256-bit SSL encryption to protect your data during checkout. Access to personal details is restricted strictly to authorized delivery partners and customer care personnel.

settings.title: 4. Cookies & Web Tracking
settings.content: Our store uses essential cookies to remember your shopping cart items, keep you logged in, and analyze website traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.

settings.heading: Privacy Policy
settings.subheading: Last updated: August 12, 2026 • We respect and protect your personal information.
